June 7, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Guild Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 11.05% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Guild Investment Management Inc bought 4,517 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 45,410 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.62M, up from 40,893 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Guild Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $949.51 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.41% or $0.8 during the last trading session, reaching $193.18. About 8.45M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 7, 2017 and is uptrending.
